items.text: Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is on IR and Tanner McKee has started since; the schedule data lists Hurts, so the model uses McKee.

Philadelphia (Wednesday estimate): RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), WR Britain Covey (knee), CB Jonathan Jones (hamstring) and LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad) did not participate; EDGE Nolan Smith (concussion), EDGE Jonathan Greenard (ankle), DB Michael Carter II and DT Moro Ojomo were limited.

Washington (Wednesday): WR Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring/rest), DT Javon Kinlaw (knee, Dan Quinn says likely out) and TE John Bates (shoulder) did not practice; WR Treylon Burks and DE Charles Omenihu were limited. Jayden Daniels (elbow) was full and starts. WR Terry McLaurin is out for the season.
